blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — All provinces in the country are expected to experience drought by March 2027 due to the increasing effects of El Niño, Science and Technology Secretary Renato Solidum Jr. warned Monday. “By the end of March, all provinces,” Solidum said during a Palace briefing when asked how many provinces were expected to experience drought or very dry conditions due to El Niño. Drought occurs when there are several consecutive months of unusually low rainfall, specifically, three consecutive months with more than 60 percent less rainfall than average, or five consecutive months with rainfall 21 to 60 percent below normal.
